name: manual_6870fb
claim: Verify a launcher against the real client and provider in one operator-approved bounded run: a throwaway home directory, a private hub port, explicit request and output-token limits, observers that print counts and reply headers but never bodies or keys, a scan of output and files for the key, and cleanup that stops only the helper identified by that private port, leaving other daemons alone.

decisions.notes: One run on orama-system fb28125e: one request, status 200, no Content-Encoding, usage accounted, exit 0. It covers a single simple turn only, not interruption mid-task.

rationale: One run on orama-system fb28125e: one request, status 200, no Content-Encoding, usage accounted, exit 0. It covers a single simple turn only, not interruption mid-task.
